pro_tips: Bring the rack manufacturer's cut sheets and anchor specs with the permit submittal; that speeds structural review.
If the rack layout is repetitive, submit a clean plan with aisle dimensions and storage heights clearly marked — vague warehouse layouts get kicked back.
Have the contractor account and contact info ready before opening the portal so the application can be filed in one sitting.
If the warehouse has fire protection equipment nearby, confirm clearances with the fire protection contractor before final layout.
